name: Brand Wagon
tagline: Company swag your team keeps instead of quietly regifting.
positioning: Brand Wagon is the swag platform for small teams that want good merch, sane budgets, and zero closets full of the wrong-size hoodies.

hero.sub: Stock a company swag closet, ship new-hire kits automatically, and stop expensing 400 branded stress balls nobody wanted. Good merch, one dashboard, no minimum-order guilt.

features.title: New-hire kits on autopilot
features.description: Connect your HR tool. Day one, a hoodie in the right size shows up at their door. You do nothing except look organized.

features.title: A closet, not a garage
features.description: We warehouse your inventory and ship on demand. No more boxes of last year's logo living under the break-room table.

features.title: Per-seat budgets that hold
features.description: Give each teammate a spend cap and a curated menu. They pick what they want; you never approve another swag request in Slack.

features.title: Ships to 90 countries
features.description: Your remote hire in Lisbon gets the same kit as the desk crew in Ohio, minus the customs drama and surprise duties.

features.title: A catalog with taste
features.description: We already killed the itchy tees and the pens that leak. What's left is stuff people wear in public on purpose.

features.title: Reorder in two clicks
features.description: Ran out of the good totes before the trade show? Reorder the exact spec you approved last time. No re-uploading logos at 11pm.

testimonials.quote: We used to keep swag in a filing cabinet and mail it ourselves. Now new hires get a kit before their laptop does, and I've reclaimed an entire afternoon a week.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The per-seat caps ended the great hoodie war of Q2. Everyone picks their own thing, nobody's over budget, and I stopped being the swag police.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ojeda

testimonials.quote: I ordered 12 things for a client dinner and every single one arrived on time and didn't look like a giveaway. That has literally never happened.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

pricing.blurb: For small teams that just want decent merch without the spreadsheet.
For growing teams with new hires, budgets, and opinions about totes.
For multi-location operators who need custom catalogs and real support.

homepage.footerBlurb: Brand Wagon stocks the closet, ships the kits, and keeps the leftover swag off your floor. Good merch, per seat, no guilt.
